messages:
Clara: opened PR to polish the Quickstart hello-world. Goals: unify SDK snippets (JS + Py), standardize REDWOOD_API_KEY, and shorten the Dockerfile. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2502. Can @Ben or @Aria review?
Ben: quick skim — SDK-first is good. Keep a single-line curl as an advanced smoke check, not the primary path. Also remove the `--platform` flag from Dockerfile so it works on ARM.
Aria: will update the Python snippet to use `RedwoodClient` and show a safe output accessor (e.g., check `resp.output`). Add a one-line migration note for users moving from older SDKs.
doc-ci: /docs/lint 1/24 checks passed: failures: missing language tag on one code fence; long line in Dockerfile example.
Clara: fixing both now: add language tags to fences and wrap Dockerfile lines. Replaced stray `REDWOOD_KEY` mentions with `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Pushed commit c9d1f2.
Ben: verified changes, LGTM. I also trimmed a sentence in the intro: "Quickstart: get running in minutes" (avoid exact minute claims).
Aria: smoke script added (`npm run smoke`) and a tiny smoke.js example for CI smoke checks. Also copied migration blurb into /guides/migration in a follow-up PR.
doc-ci: re-run: all checks passed for PR 2502.
Clara: thanks everyone — merging after final CI gating and will backport the migration note into the release notes. :rocket:
